message.content:
This editorial illustration features a blue background with red and white text at the top. The large white word "TEMPO" is centered above the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." Two illustrations of men stand in the center. The foreground figure is a man with gray hair and glasses, wearing a long-sleeved white shirt. Behind him and slightly to the right, a second man in a dark gray suit and black pecap (songkok) hat grips the first man’s upper arms with both hands.

In the bottom foreground, several red-brown textured hands are raised. One hand on the right holds a dark gray megaphone with a circular opening. On the left and right, large, rectangular red-brown wooden signs are held aloft.

Text at the top includes "Uji Bukti Mendakwa Nadiem Makarim H.63" and "Lintang Pukang 3 Juta Rumah H.72." Large black text reads "GULA-GULA DEMO BURUH" above a paragraph of smaller black text starting with "Presiden Prabowo menunjuk..." and ending with "H.26." The bottom left corner displays "4-10 MEI 2026," "RP 60.000," publication details, and a barcode with a QR code.
